_comment: Single source for the response headers of /strata-editor/facebind/. The Content-Security-Policy is the page's <meta> policy plus frame-ancestors (which only works as a header). page.test.mjs fails if this drifts from the <meta>. The overrides entry is for the embedded VRM editor build (docs/facebind/editor): its <meta> CSP plus frame-ancestors 'self', so only the facebind page can frame it.

headers.Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval' 'sha256-9UQGbCfi1dg1RZD9yUpmzSiGI6acfQOXLGHtJclwhCM='; style-src 'unsafe-inline'; img-src blob: data:; connect-src 'self' blob: https://raw.githubusercontent.com; worker-src 'none'; frame-src 'self'; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'

default-src 'none'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' blob: data:; font-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self' blob: data:; media-src blob:; worker-src 'self' blob:; form-action 'none'; base-uri 'none'; frame-ancestors 'self'
